rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that someone sings or plays in a pleasing, melodious way.

example.english: I played the guitar melodiously, and even the neighbours said it was great.
example.traditional: 我彈結他彈得好聽，連隔籬屋都話正。
example.jyutping: ngo5 taan4 git6 taa1 taan4 dak1 hou2 teng1 lin4 gaak3 lei4 uk1 dou1 waa6 zeng3
